definitions.explanation: A kitchen or laboratory tool with a fine mesh used to separate fine particles from coarser ones, especially for sifting flour or straining liquids.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小麦粉|こむぎこ}→小麦粉：04922_komugiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ふるい⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
ふるい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{粉砂糖|こなざとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}りかけた→振りかける：21485_furikakeru⟧。
examples.english: I dusted on powdered sugar with a sieve.

examples.japanese: ⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦{砂利|じゃり}→砂利：14948_jari⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分|わ}ける→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ふるい⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I used a sieve in the garden to separate fine gravel from soil.

notes:
Written in kanji as {篩|ふるい}, but the kana form is more common in everyday writing. The noun form of the verb {篩|ふる}う (to sift).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ふるい⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to sift; to put through a sieve (also figurative: to screen, filter out)
- ⟦{粉|こな}→粉：02766_kona⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ふるう: to sift flour
- ふるい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧こす: to strain through a sieve

USAGE:
ふるい⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ is also used figuratively for screening or filtering people or candidates: ⟦{応募者|おうぼしゃ}→応募者：20440_oubosha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ふるい⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ (to screen applicants).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ざる→ざる：04470_zaru⟧: colander; sieve basket — coarser mesh, typically for draining noodles or rinsing vegetables
- こし{器|き}: strainer — for liquids, finer than ⟦ざる→ざる：04470_zaru⟧
